text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I heard a student call out to me, and the
minute I
turned around, she shoved
these chocolates in my
hands...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Then she ran off. I didn't even have time
to think.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Her form was pretty good though.
What class is
she in?
